remarks: Welcome home to the Chesterfield community. one of Stamford's premier and most sought-after gated communities. Don't miss an opportunity to own this first-floor unit with 2-bedrooms, 2-bathrooms located in a desirable section of the complex and features move-in ready condition with an exceptional combination of privacy and space. The property includes a deeded one-car garage, immediately accessible from your back door with a loft for additional storage-an uncommon amenity within Chesterfield. A bright and spacious living room is highlighted by a cozy wood-burning fireplace and gleaming hardwood flooring throughout. The dining room opens onto a private deck, while the modern kitchen boasts granite countertops, a tiled backsplash, and stainless-steel appliances (2021), while additional updates include an in-unit washer and dryer (2021) and a newer HVAC/central air system (2021). Residents enjoy 24-hour security, two swimming pools, a clubhouse, and the convenience of an onsite Property Manager supporting a secure and welcoming community atmosphere. Chesterfield's prime location offers easy access to parks, Ridgeway Center shopping, restaurants, health clubs, vibrant downtown Stamford, I-95, Merritt Parkway, and Metro North train. When showing - PLEASE TAKE OFF YOUR SHOES OR WEAR BOOTIES AND SHUT OFF ALL LIGHTS
